utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Moreno Valley' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Moreno Valley is not a Western Community Energy member city (Eastvale, Hemet, Jurupa Valley, Norco, Perris, and Wildomar are); Western Community Energy itself deregistered with the CPUC and dissolved via Chapter 9 bankruptcy in 2021. No current CCA was found serving Moreno Valley.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Moreno Valley/Riverside County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: Schedule online through SimpliCITY, or call the Inspection line at 951-413-3380, or email buildinginspections@moval.org
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building and Safety Division inspection scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.
